method.cohort: 235 previously approved setups, 3 August–18 November 2026 through 07:45 Nepal; fixed cohort, not requalified using the added zone warmup history.
method.zones: M15 active valid opposing structural zone known at confirmation close, before the original TP for either planned leg. Plain, Fib, completed engulfing confirmation, and Fib+confirmation variants fixed before viewing results. M15 zone analysis has up to 5000 prior closed bars; H1/H4/D support has up to 1500. Under 500 M15 bars is unknown, not no-zone; those setups are retained unchanged by zone filters. Assessed-only, 2000-bar and 5000-bar sensitivities are separate.
method.delay: Orders activate at the second candle open after confirmation, only after the first candle closes; retain original two limit prices, fixed exits, 60/40 budget and original expiry (60 minutes remain). Cancel if the first waiting candle touched an original SL/TP. Same-direction variant rejects dojis and opposite closes. Original limit-price fills are used consistently, without credit for favorable opening-gap improvement. Separate market variants enter at that next open with original fixed SL/TP, resize to the same 60/40 full-setup risk and require a positive stop/target geometry with stop <=300 pips; the two legs have the same market price.
method.costs: Fixed full-setup risk; returns weighted 60/40. Gross and illustrative 0.30 / 0.60 Gold price-unit round-trip cost deductions per closed leg, scaled by its planned stop distance. Not observed spreads/commission; does not resimulate bid/ask execution or lot rounding.
method.uncertainty: Known closed-leg returns only; uncertain outcomes and unproven fills are reported separately, not treated as known wins/losses. Broad gross bounds allow each uncertain filled/unproven leg to lose its allocated share or gain its planned share*RR, so they are conservative scenario bounds, not confidence intervals. Common-determinate pairs exclude uncertainty from both versions. Closed-equity drawdown excludes uncertain/open positions and overlapping intratrade exposure; it is not live portfolio drawdown.
method.validation: Production baseline reconciles all 416 entry arrows, 216 TP, 150 SL and +45.834743R. Earlier/later and monthly comparisons below are retrospective robustness checks, not untouched holdouts. No live code/settings changed.
